title.narrative: Improve access to equitable, quality and lifesaving healthcare services for the vulnerable populations in Afmadow district, lower juba region.

description.narrative: ltpgtAlight’s proposed health programming will be implemented in close coordination and collaboration with respective Government bodies including Jubaland MOH, Federal Ministry of Health, UN Partners such as WHO, UNICEF, UNFPA, WFP, SHF partners, and other health cluster partners. Alight will focus its interventions on the provision of primary healthcare services through the existing health facility infrastructures to meet the rapidly growing needs occasioned by cyclic natural disasters. Alight is proposing to support two fixed health facilities (Waberi HC Bulaweyn PHU in Dhobley and Afmadow towns respectively) and 2 mobile clinics covering Tula-xubi,Hagar dabatag,Abdi Sugow,Kulmis,Osman jesow and camp Xawina in Dhobley and Camp Soya,Camp Bari,Camp Abaq-Bamabow,Camp Yaq,Camp Abaq and Bula-gumar villages in Afmadow district, Lower Juba region, targeting to reach a population of 57,879 (26,279 Women, 6,152Girls, 18, 485Men, 6,963 Boys). A significant focus will be placed on supporting female-headed households, as well as pregnant and lactating women who are particularly vulnerable to health-related risks. Children between the ages of six months and five years will also be a programming priority, as they face significant risks from malnutrition-related health complications.ltbrgtThis critical and life-saving health response will be carried out through quick impact support to meet immediate needs in primary health centers (PHCs) in areas where an anticipated Lalina will hit hard and health facilities with funding gaps and no health actor in that area. Alight will support an integrated and quality basic health care package of primary health care services with emergency referrals, disease surveillance, and reproductive and mental health services. ALIGHT will enhance the provision of equitable and quality lifesaving healthcare services through TWO fixed sites/Health facilities and 2 mobile clinics and provide health services in tandem with the essential package of healthcare services (EPHS) such as clinical care across all age groups and genders (women, girls, boys, and men) as well as the disabled, the minorities, and the marginalized population.ltbrgtThe proposed project will enhance the provision of life-saving primary health care services through fixed and outreach services through the essential package of health services (EPHS) such as clinical care, child health care, immunization, communicable disease treatment, and emergency treatment, cholera/AWD awareness and treatment for communicable and non-communicable diseases. ALIGHT will Prepositioning and provision of essential medicines and supplies to support facilities. The project will ensure the provision of sexual and reproductive health services (ANC, PNC, safe deliveries, dignity kits for pregnant mothers, and CMR, including referral mechanisms and improve access to trauma care services. ALIGHT teams will provide basic mental health/psychosocial services and referrals, enhance Infection Prevention and Control (IPC), and undertake health awareness, social mobilization, education, and advocacy activities in disease control, and the general well-being, including PSEA, health through CHWs or other mechanism like key informants. The project will undertake surveillance and first response to disease outbreaks for effective control and preventative measures.ltbrgtlt/pgt
